title: Annotation API v2 NER response
description: Response body of POST /api/v2/entities/ner/. Same envelope as /api/ner/; the entities are the batch NER entities.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

sys_id.description: Identifier of the system (model) that served the request.

nes.description: Named entity mentions found in the text; `[]` when nothing is found.

NER seconds.description: NER processing time in seconds. Frozen wire name containing a space.

NEL seconds.description: Always 0 for this endpoint, which does no linking. Frozen wire name containing a space.
